breaking.change: `cascade_map`, the sun's shadow cascades a lit shader has in scope, is now a `texture_storage_2d_array<r32float, read>` instead of a `texture_2d_array<f32>`, so it takes none of a lit pipeline's sixteen texture slots. Every engine read of it was already a `textureLoad`; the picture is unchanged.
breaking.fix: Drop the mip level from a `textureLoad(cascade_map, at, layer, 0)` in your material shader: `textureLoad(cascade_map, at, layer)`.
